title: Baby in Big Hat on Floor with Siblings, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Cute, huh? The hat was the kids idea. I think I should have been a bit closer. 215D
description: A delightful 1950s domestic snapshot depicting an infant propped up on a bed pillow in the middle of a polished hardwood floor, wearing an oversized adult hat. In the foreground, two older siblings look on at their handiwork. The deckled-edge print features a charming handwritten note from the photographer noting that dressing the baby in the hat was the children's idea, capturing a classic mid-century moment of everyday family humor.
